transcription.text: How do we keep safe on the road?
Can I ride a bike to school?
No. Children under 12 years old can't ride on the road.
Dad, can I skate to school?
We can't skate on the road.
I, i, kid, o, o, cross.
What should we do on the road?
Wait on the pavement until it turns green.
Now the light is green, it's okay to go.
Don't run too fast, but don't walk too slow.
A. Listen and choose, then say.
Yes. The girl is under 12 years old.
She can't ride a bike on the road.
Traffic signs keep us safe on the road.
Some people are working on the road.
You can cross the road here.
